_why: 3.7 Scorching Ray: a Wizard learns it at level 3 and aims two rays at the lead mire-rat and one at the rear rat (the sidebar's dart allocation, set here on the Cast step). Each ray is its own ranged spell attack and its own 2d6 fire hit; a ray aimed at a rat an earlier ray dropped is spent. Seeded, with refresh, so a re-roll on replay would show.
